excerpt.zh: 太空兽群会将我们的种荚带到遥远的土地。只要一抹星光，我们的种子就能绽放为新的殖民地。
excerpt.en: Spaceborne fauna will carry our Seed Pods to distant lands. With a touch of starlight, our seeds can bloom into a new colony.
